Development vs Adult

Each point is a locus|gene pair. Above the diagonal = stronger signal in development. The y axis is compressed below 0.8, where most pairs have no fetal signal at all.

Locus panel

Click a point with signal in development to open the region: local Manhattan with the colocalization lead SNP, cell-type-resolved PLAC-seq arcs from fetal cortex, and the gene track. Everything is on the same x axis in hg38, so the variant, the contacts and the target gene line up vertically.

Tracks and sources
−log10 p consensus AD GWAS (2026)
RG/IPC/eN/iN ATAC Song 2020, cell-type ATAC (bigWig, hg38)
RG/IPC/eN/iN arcs Song 2020, PLAC-seq — H3K4me3-anchored, so promoter-proximal contacts cannot appear
ChromHMM Rahman 2023, fetal cortical plate chromatin states
co-accessibility Domcke 2020, fetal cerebrum Cicero (hg19 lifted to hg38) — correlation between accessible sites, not physical contact
genes UCSC RefSeq (hg38)
Marks
GWAS lead SNP (lowest p in the window)
colocalization variant, at its GWAS p-value
selected pair (click a point above)
genome-wide significance (5e−8)
target gene of the clicked pair
Arc conventions
both anchors inside the window
one anchor outside — dotted, with a triangle at the border
arc height scales with span, relative to the window width
ChromHMM states (background state 1 is not drawn)
Polycomb repressed
Non-active TSS
TSS flanking
Active TSS
Active enhancer
All layers are hg38. Arcs are capped at the top 40 per track per window.
